info.title: CanvasNet Tool
info.description: DemaConsulting.CanvasNet.Tool is the canvasnet command-line tool: it inspects, renders, and transforms images and documents (PNG, JPEG, BMP, TIFF, GIF, JPEG 2000, SVG, PDF, PowerPoint, Visio, and OpenSCAD models) using the CanvasNet libraries, with a stable machine-readable JSON contract so that scripts and AI agents can drive it.

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Measure how much two images differ (MAE, RMSE, PSNR, SSIM), and draw the differences

options.name: --page
options.description: The page or slide to render, counted from 1 (default 1)

options.name: --dpi
options.description: Resolution of a PDF, PPTX, or VSDX page in dots per inch (default 96; VSDX needs a whole number)

options.name: --a-page
options.description: The page or slide of the first input, counted from 1 (a document only; overrides --page)

options.name: --b-page
options.description: The page or slide of the second input, counted from 1 (a document only; overrides --page)

options.name: --a-dpi
options.description: Resolution of the first input in dots per inch (a document only; overrides --dpi)

options.name: --b-dpi
options.description: Resolution of the second input in dots per inch (a document only; overrides --dpi)

options.name: --background
options.description: Opaque color that transparency is flattened over: white (default), black, #RRGGBB, or a color name

options.name: --no-auto-orient
options.description: Do not turn a JPEG upright according to its EXIF orientation

options.name: --strict
options.description: Fail with unsupported-feature instead of skipping a picture or shape the library cannot draw

options.name: --view
options.description: SCAD model: the viewpoint - iso (default), front, back, left, right, top, or bottom

options.name: --azimuth
options.description: SCAD model: replace the azimuth of the view, in degrees about the Z axis (0 = from the front)

options.name: --elevation
options.description: SCAD model: replace the elevation of the view, in degrees above the XY plane (-90 to 90)

options.name: --projection
options.description: SCAD model: ortho (default) or perspective

options.name: --define
options.description: SCAD model: set a variable, for example -D width=20 or -D label=text (repeatable)

options.name: --time
options.description: SCAD model: the value of $t, the animation time (default 0)

options.name: --default-color
options.description: SCAD model: the color of surfaces the model does not color (default gray)

options.name: --max-triangles
options.description: SCAD model: the most triangles the model may produce (default 5000000)

options.name: --a-view
options.description: SCAD model: the viewpoint of the first input (overrides --view)

options.name: --b-view
options.description: SCAD model: the viewpoint of the second input (overrides --view)

options.name: --a-define
options.description: SCAD model: set a variable of the first input (repeatable; wins over -D of the same name)

options.name: --b-define
options.description: SCAD model: set a variable of the second input (repeatable; wins over -D of the same name)

options.name: --resize-to
options.description: Bring both inputs to one size: a (the size of the first input), b (the second), or WxH

options.name: --fit
options.description: How a raster input is fitted to --resize-to: contain (default; keeps the aspect ratio, with margins) or stretch

options.name: --filter
options.description: Resampling filter of a resize or fit: auto (default), nearest, bilinear, bicubic, lanczos3, or area

options.name: --tolerance
options.description: A pixel differs when a channel differs by more than this, 0-255 (default 8)

options.name: --grid
options.description: Report the error of each cell of a grid, columns x rows, each 1-64 (default 4x4)

options.name: --threshold
options.description: Fail (exit code 1) unless a metric is within a limit: mae, rmse, max-diff, diff-ratio, or cell-rmse at most; psnr or ssim at least (repeatable)

options.name: --diff
options.description: Write a picture of the differences to this file

options.name: --diff-style
options.description: How --diff draws a difference: heat (default) or abs; --side-by-side always uses heat

options.name: --gain
options.description: Amplification of a difference in the pictures, 0.1-255 (default 4)

options.name: --side-by-side
options.description: Write the first input, the second input, and the differences side by side to this file

options.name: --overlay
options.description: Write a blend of both inputs to this file

options.name: --overlay-weight
options.description: Weight of the second input in --overlay, 0-1 (default 0.5)

options.name: --quality
options.description: JPEG quality, 1-100 (default 90)

options.name: --no-clobber
options.description: Fail instead of overwriting an existing output file

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help message

options.name: --silent
options.description: Suppress console output

options.name: --validate
options.description: Run self-validation

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the result as one JSON document to standard output

options.name: --results
options.description: Write validation results to file (.trx or .xml)

options.name: --depth
options.description: Set heading depth for markdown output (default: 1)

options.name: --log
options.description:
Write output to log file
--diff, --side-by-side, and --overlay write pictures of the differences. --threshold makes the command fail
--page, --dpi, and the SCAD options apply to both inputs; --a-page, --b-page, --a-dpi, --b-dpi, --a-view,
--b-view, --a-define, and --b-define apply to one input and win.

commands.name: convert
commands.description: Render or convert an image, drawing, or document page to PNG, JPEG, BMP, or TIFF, with optional transformations

options.name: --page
options.description: The page or slide to render, counted from 1 (default 1)

options.name: --all-pages
options.description: Render every page or slide; the output must contain {page} or be a directory

options.name: --dpi
options.description: Resolution of a PDF, PPTX, or VSDX page in dots per inch (default 96; VSDX needs a whole number)

options.name: --scale
options.description: Multiply the natural size by a factor, for example 2 or 0.5

options.name: --width
options.description: Target width in pixels; the height keeps the aspect ratio unless --height is given

options.name: --height
options.description: Target height in pixels; the width keeps the aspect ratio unless --width is given

options.name: --size
options.description: Exact target size, for example 800x600 (shorthand for --width and --height)

options.name: --background
options.description: Color to flatten transparency over: white (default for vector sources), black, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA, transparent

options.name: --no-auto-orient
options.description: Do not turn a JPEG upright according to its EXIF orientation

options.name: --strict
options.description: Fail with unsupported-feature instead of skipping a picture or shape the library cannot draw

options.name: --view
options.description: SCAD model: the viewpoint - iso (default), front, back, left, right, top, or bottom

options.name: --azimuth
options.description: SCAD model: replace the azimuth of the view, in degrees about the Z axis (0 = from the front)

options.name: --elevation
options.description: SCAD model: replace the elevation of the view, in degrees above the XY plane (-90 to 90)

options.name: --projection
options.description: SCAD model: ortho (default) or perspective

options.name: --define
options.description: SCAD model: set a variable, for example -D width=20 or -D label=text (repeatable)

options.name: --time
options.description: SCAD model: the value of $t, the animation time (default 0)

options.name: --default-color
options.description: SCAD model: the color of surfaces the model does not color (default gray)

options.name: --max-triangles
options.description: SCAD model: the most triangles the model may produce (default 5000000)

options.name: --crop
options.description: Crop to a rectangle x,y,w,h or WxH+X+Y, each value in pixels or percent (repeatable; operations run in the order written)

options.name: --resize
options.description: Resample to exactly this size, for example 800x600

options.name: --fit
options.description: Shrink to fit inside this box, keeping the aspect ratio (an image that already fits is unchanged)

options.name: --allow-upscale
options.description: Let --fit enlarge an image that is smaller than the box

options.name: --rotate
options.description: Rotate clockwise by any angle in degrees, for example 90 or -3.5; an angle that is not a multiple of 90 grows the canvas and fills the corners (see --rotate-fill)

options.name: --rotate-fill
options.description: Color of the corners a --rotate or --deskew exposes (default: the --background, else white for an opaque image, else transparent)

options.name: --flip
options.description: Mirror: h (left to right), v (top to bottom), or both

options.name: --pad
options.description: Add a border of N pixels on every side, or l,t,r,b pixels on each side

options.name: --pad-color
options.description: Color of the border added by --pad (default: the --background, else white for a drawing or document, else transparent)

options.name: --grayscale
options.description: Turn every pixel gray (its luma); transparency is kept

options.name: --invert
options.description: Invert the colors; transparency is kept

options.name: --threshold
options.description: Turn the image black and white: pixels with a luma above the level (0-255) become white; auto chooses the level with Otsu's method

options.name: --levels
options.description: Map the levels black..white to 0..255, with an optional gamma (0.1-10; above 1 brightens the midtones), for example 20,230 or 20,230,1.2

options.name: --brightness
options.description: Add an amount (-255 to 255) to every color level

options.name: --contrast
options.description: Change the contrast around mid-gray by a percentage (-100 to 100)

options.name: --auto-levels
options.description: Stretch the levels so the darkest and lightest pixels become black and white (ignoring 1% of the pixels at each end; see --auto-levels-clip)

options.name: --auto-levels-clip
options.description: Percentage of the pixels --auto-levels ignores at each end, 0-20 (default 1)

options.name: --deskew
options.description: Straighten the image: find the tilt of its near-horizontal lines (within 15 degrees) and rotate it level; the angle is in the --json result

options.name: --trim
options.description: Crop away the uniform border around the content (the background is the most common color of the four corners)

options.name: --trim-tolerance
options.description: How far a pixel may differ from the background and still count as background, 0-255 (default 8)

options.name: --grid
options.description: Draw a labeled coordinate grid with a line every N pixels (8-4096) in the color given (default #FF00FFA0); put it last to read the final coordinates

options.name: --filter
options.description: Resampling filter of a resize or fit: auto (default), nearest, bilinear, bicubic, lanczos3, or area

options.name: --output
options.description: The output file; its extension selects the format

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: png, jpeg, bmp, or tiff (overrides the extension)

options.name: --quality
options.description: JPEG quality, 1-100 (default 90)

options.name: --no-clobber
options.description: Fail instead of overwriting an existing output file

options.description: Display version information

options.description: Display this help message

options.description: Suppress console output

options.name: --results
